title: MODE 2-1: 1-VAR
summary: Single-variable stats including n, mean, σx/sx, min/max, Q1, median, Q3.

body.text: Use for lists, test scores, and any one-column frequency analysis. Enable FREQ in SET UP when values repeat.

body.caption: The STAT hub example 15, 18, 22, 25. After AC, SHIFT 1 → Var → x̄ gives 20.
1-VAR also recalls quartiles from MinMax (Q1, med, Q3). That five-number picture is not available in fx-50FH II SD mode.
